title: The Effects of Directed Therapeutic Intent on Live and Damaged Cells
description: This case study records physiological and EEG data from a self-described practitioner of energy medicine who performed directed therapeutic intent on live and damaged cells. Across 60 double-blind treatment and control sessions, cell types (live, dead/x-rayed, or medium only) were randomized and concealed from both the practitioner and the experimenter. Matched control cells treated by a sham therapist provide behavioral measures of cellular outcomes.
methods_description: Data were collected in 40 sessions over 10 days, each about 25 minutes and split into five segments: a 2-minute pre-baseline, three 5-minute treatment periods (still, movement allowed, still), and a 2-minute post-baseline. Cell type presentation was randomized under double-blind conditions. Matching control cells were treated by a sham therapist at a separate location.
